description_en: Queries the time-series metrics of tokens per minute (TPM) for DataAgent analysis task model usage within a specified time range, returning token consumption at each time point at a minute-level granularity
description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内DataAgent分析任务模型用量的TPM时序指标，按分钟粒度返回各时间点的Token消耗量
kebab_example: aliyun dms get-data-agent-task-model-usage-metrics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --begin-time 1735660800 --end-time 1735747200 --pay-level example-string --instance-ids example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataAgentTaskModelUsageMetrics

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The recommended time range is up to one month
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的开始时间，取值为Unix时间戳，单位为秒(建议区间长度不大于一月)
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The recommended time range is up to one month
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围的结束时间，取值为Unix时间戳，单位为秒(建议区间长度不大于一月)
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The list of billing instance IDs to query
parameters.name: instance_ids

Data.description_en: The list of time-series TPM metrics for model usage. The usage at each time point is returned in chronological order
Data.description_zh: 模型用量的TPM时序指标列表，按时间顺序返回各时间点的用量

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the statistical interval for the time-series point. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
BeginTime.description_zh: 该时序点统计区间的开始时间，取值为Unix时间戳，单位为秒

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the statistical interval for the time-series point. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 该时序点统计区间的结束时间，取值为Unix时间戳，单位为秒

Tpm.description_en: The TPM at the time-series point, which represents the number of tokens consumed in the statistical interval
Tpm.description_zh: 该时序点的TPM，即该统计区间内消耗的Token数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code, which is returned when a request exception occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message, which is returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志、排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
